notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
- Prevented unwanted solutions in Dissipation and Hoist.
- Tweaked some level decorations.
- Added missing level thumbnail.
- Bug fix: Cloned blocks were not updated if player picks up the source block and the duplicator is immediately occupied by another block.
- Bug fix: Background panels did not flash when misplacing a block if the level had been restarted.
- Bug fix: Player could end up inside a closed gate if its state was toggled while carrying it
- Bug fix: Player was able to fall through some piston blocks when undoing

Stay tuned for more content!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
- Three new levels! Tangle, Safecracker and Hoist.
- Tweaked Pit level layout.
- Bug fix: Tutorials for keyboard could be displayed when a keyboard was not in use
- Bug fix: Undoing past atom collection let the player keep the atom in some circumstances.
- Bug fix: An open gate could momentarily be closed when placed down causing incorrect results with some receptor+gate+beam interactions.
- Bug fix: Player movement could appear stuttery when pushed from above.
- Bug fix: The line emanating from a receptor could appear in the wrong place if the receptor block is pushed.
- Bug fix: World map background didn't update until cursor was moved.
- Bug fix: It was possible to restart level or undo while menu is open.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
- Extended touch input area to cover more of the screen
- Level names are shown when a level is started
- Added menu option for disabling tutorials and other text prints, like the level names
- Tuned tutorial text timings and positions
- Fixed unwanted solutions in The Vault and Lockpick
- Lowered overall audio volume level

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
- Improved tutorial text placements for playing in a portrait display.
- Pit level layout updated to prevent unwanted solutions.
- The Vault level layout tweaked for clarity and comfort.
- Touch UI: Made it more difficult to accidentally reveal debug menu.
- Bug Fix: Graphics menu items were selected in a funny order when using a controller or keyboard.
- Bug Fix: Potential fix for some of the visuals not appearing as pixel perfect on some PCs.
- Bug Fix: Player won't stop walking if menu is opened.

notes.title: Prerelease v1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
- Added backgrounds behind tutorial texts.
- Moved game logo from world map to splash screen.
- Tweaked some menu titles, ordering and visuals.
- Mobile: Removed player turning stop time.
- Mobile: Implemented a more dependable backbuffer clearing for the edges of the screen.
- Mobile: Viewport logs are now hidden by default.
- Bug fix: Game did not store full screen setting properly when switching with alt+enter.
- Bug fix: It was possible to highlight two menu items simultaneously when using a mouse.

notes.title: Prerelease 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
- Achievement added: Stacker. Stack 6 blocks in a straight vertical line.
- Level decorations added.
- Tweaked Pit level layout to prevent unintended solution.
- World map: Swapped Supermax and Squeezebox levels. Saved games from previous versions may exhibit weird level progression if one but not the other level has been complete.
- World map: Removed level Balance. If I can make it more interesting it'll return. :)
- World map: Logo added.
- World map: Background color changes according to cursor position.
- Bug fix: Climbing against a beam pushing from above at a certain height caused stuttery SFX and lacked visual feedback.
- Bug fix: Player could start stuttering after landing if player simultaneously looked up or down.
- Bug fix: Water surface didn't oscillate as it should when walking against level border

notes.title: Stuffo Prerelease v1.0.0 Update
notes.content:
Changelist:
- Changed version number format from calendar versioning to traditional semantic versioning (now 1.0.0)
- New level: Ideal State
- Changed locations of levels (Components, Wimble and Scales).
- PC: Using debug/cheat keys now requires setting "DebugMode" to 1 in %userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Hapatus\Stuffo\settings.json
- Renamed Transportable Transporter to Transportable Teleport so that the text doesn't wrap to two lines :)
- Made transitions of multiple clone blocks more rapid to prevent undefined edge cases
- Controls/gamefeel: Added a very brief pause before walking starts after player changes directions
- Bug Fix: Added safeguards for cases where the player might incorrectly fall through a piston block's extender on undo
- Bug Fix: Occupying a clone block's space and initiating cloning caused a state that was not properly replicated by undoing. Cloning will no longer be initiated if player occupies a clone block's space.
- Bug Fix: Player was able to duplicate blocks by occupying a clone block's space and initializing cloning. Cloning will no longer be initiated if player occupies a clone block's space.
